mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_order(id, payment_no, request_idempotency_key, checkout_batch_id, payment_scene, buyer_user_id, pay_channel, channel_order_mode, channel_app_id, channel_mch_id, channel_notify_url, channel_combine_out_trade_no, payer_openid, payment_status, payable_amount_fen, paid_amount_fen, refunded_amount_fen, expire_at, created_at, updated_at, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{payment.id}, #{payment.paymentNo}, #{payment.requestIdempotencyKey}, #{payment.checkoutBatchId}, 'initial_order', #{payment.buyerUserId}, 'wechat_pay', 'combine_jsapi', #{payment.channelAppId}, #{payment.channelMchId}, #{payment.channelNotifyUrl}, #{payment.channelCombineOutTradeNo}, #{payment.payerOpenid}, 'pending', #{payment.payableAmountFen}, 0, 0, #{payment.expireAt}, #{payment.createdAt}, #{payment.updatedAt}, #{payment.nextAttemptAt})

INSERT INTO payment_channel_suborder(id, payment_order_id, factory_id, factory_wechat_account_id, sub_mchid_snapshot, channel_sub_order_no, channel_suborder_amount_fen, channel_suborder_status, channel_description, profit_sharing_flag, payment_status, paid_amount_fen, refunded_amount_fen, freeze_alert_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{suborder.id}, #{suborder.paymentOrderId}, #{suborder.factoryId}, #{suborder.factoryWechatAccountId}, #{suborder.subMchidSnapshot}, #{suborder.channelSubOrderNo}, #{suborder.channelSuborderAmountFen}, 'pending', #{suborder.channelDescription}, 1, 'pending', 0, 0, 'none', #{suborder.createdAt}, #{suborder.updatedAt})

SELECT id, payment_no, request_idempotency_key, checkout_batch_id, buyer_user_id, channel_app_id, channel_mch_id, channel_notify_url, channel_prepay_id, channel_combine_out_trade_no, payer_openid, channel_trade_state, payment_status, payable_amount_fen, paid_amount_fen, refunded_amount_fen, expire_at, paid_at, closed_at, version, created_at, updated_at, next_attempt_at, last_checked_at, attempt_count, last_error_code, close_requested_at, close_reason FROM payment_order WHERE checkout_batch_id=#{id}
FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, payment_no, request_idempotency_key, checkout_batch_id, buyer_user_id, channel_app_id, channel_mch_id, channel_notify_url, channel_prepay_id, channel_combine_out_trade_no, payer_openid, channel_trade_state, payment_status, payable_amount_fen, paid_amount_fen, refunded_amount_fen, expire_at, paid_at, closed_at, version, created_at, updated_at, next_attempt_at, last_checked_at, attempt_count, last_error_code, close_requested_at, close_reason FROM payment_order WHERE id=#{id}
FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT id, payment_order_id, factory_id, factory_wechat_account_id, sub_mchid_snapshot, channel_sub_order_no, channel_sub_transaction_id, channel_suborder_amount_fen, channel_suborder_status, rental_order_id, channel_description, profit_sharing_flag, payment_status, channel_trade_state, paid_amount_fen, refunded_amount_fen, paid_at, closed_at, version, freeze_expire_at, freeze_alert_status, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_channel_suborder
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET next_attempt_at=#{attempt.next}, last_checked_at=#{attempt.now}, attempt_count=attempt_count+1, version=version+1, updated_at=#{attempt.now} WHERE id=#{attempt.id} AND version=#{attempt.version} AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at<=#{attempt.now})

UPDATE payment_order SET channel_prepay_id=COALESCE(channel_prepay_id, #{finish.prepayId}), payment_status=CASE WHEN #{finish.prepayId} IS NOT NULL AND payment_status='pending' THEN 'paying' ELSE payment_status END, last_error_code=#{finish.errorCode}, next_attempt_at=#{finish.next}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{finish.now} WHERE id=#{finish.id} AND version=#{finish.version}

UPDATE payment_channel_suborder SET channel_sub_transaction_id=#{fact.transactionId}, payment_status='success', channel_trade_state=#{fact.tradeState}, channel_suborder_status=CASE WHEN refunded_amount_fen=channel_suborder_amount_fen THEN 'fully_refunded' WHEN refunded_amount_fen>0 THEN 'partially_refunded' ELSE 'paid_frozen' END, paid_amount_fen=#{fact.paidFen}, paid_at=#{fact.paidAt}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{fact.now} WHERE id=#{fact.id} AND payment_status!='success'

UPDATE payment_channel_suborder SET payment_status='closed', channel_suborder_status='closed', channel_trade_state='CLOSED', closed_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND payment_status NOT IN ('success', 'closed')

UPDATE payment_order SET payment_status=#{summary.status}, paid_amount_fen=#{summary.paidFen}, paid_at=#{summary.paidAt}, channel_trade_state=#{summary.tradeState}, last_checked_at=#{summary.now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{summary.now} WHERE id=#{summary.id}

UPDATE payment_order SET close_requested_at=COALESCE(close_requested_at, #{now}), close_reason=COALESCE(close_reason, #{reason}), next_attempt_at=COALESCE(next_attempt_at, #{now}), version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND payment_status NOT IN ('success', 'closed', 'expired')
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(p.checkout_batch_id,p.id) FROM payment_order p LEFT JOIN checkout_batch b ON b.id=p.checkout_batch_id WHERE p.payment_scene IN ('initial_order','extension_rent','compensation_supplement','custom_order_full_payment') AND (p.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR p.next_attempt_at<=#{now}) AND (p.payment_status IN ('pending', 'paying', 'partial_received') OR (p.payment_status='closed' AND b.batch_status='pending_payment') OR b.batch_status IN ('payment_exception', 'refund_processing')) ORDER BY p.next_attempt_at, p.id LIMIT 100

mapper.select: SELECT payment_scene scene,related_extension_request_id extension_id,related_compensation_receivable_id receivable_id,(SELECT s.custom_order_id FROM payment_channel_suborder s WHERE s.payment_order_id=p.id AND s.custom_order_id IS NOT NULL) custom_order_id FROM payment_order p WHERE id=#{id}
